title: Edit Distance
summary: Return the minimum insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to transform one string into another.
statement: Return the minimum insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to transform one string into another. Implement `edit_distance` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Each prefix pair depends on delete, insert, and replace choices.
Build one dynamic-programming row at a time for prefixes of both strings.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the edit_distance invariant is complete.
Editorial: Build one dynamic-programming row at a time for prefixes of both strings. The intended bounds are O(nm) time and O(m) space.
